skill.name: lead-research-assistant

skill.summary: Researches and prioritizes qualified sales leads with fit scores and outreach guidance.

content.value_statement: Finding qualified prospects takes time and often produces scattered notes. This skill turns product context and customer criteria into prioritized lead lists with outreach guidance.
actual_capabilities: Guides research for companies that match an ideal customer profile.
Uses product details, industry, company size, location, and pain points to qualify leads.
Ranks leads with a 1-10 fit score and supporting reasons.
Suggests target roles, outreach angles, value propositions, and conversation starters.
Formats results as a scannable lead research report.
Can use repository context when the user runs it from a product codebase.
limitations: It depends on the AI agent's available search and browsing tools.
It does not verify private contact data or guarantee deliverability.
Fit scores are research aids, not final sales qualification decisions.
Users must follow privacy, consent, and anti-spam rules.

use_cases.title: Build Target Account Lists
use_cases.description: Create a ranked list of companies that match a sales team's ideal customer profile.

use_cases.title: Find Early Adopters
use_cases.description: Identify companies with visible pain points that match a startup product.

use_cases.title: Research Partnership Prospects
use_cases.description: Find companies that may benefit from a service, integration, or partnership offer.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Leads
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a product and target market.
prompt_templates.prompt: I sell [product or service]. Find 10 companies in [industry or location] that could be strong leads. Include fit reasons and outreach ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Use My Customer Profile
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused search using known qualification criteria.
prompt_templates.prompt: My ideal customer is [company size], in [industry], with [pain point]. Find 15 leads and score each one from 1 to 10.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze My Repository First
prompt_templates.scenario: Use product code context before researching accounts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository to understand the product. Then find 10 companies that would benefit from it and explain the best outreach angle.

prompt_templates.title: Build Prioritized Account Research
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research with constraints, scoring, and next steps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 20 qualified leads for [product]. Use these constraints: [industries], [regions], [company size], [tech stack], and [budget signals]. Include priority scores, target roles, and next actions.

output_examples.input: I sell compliance automation to fintech startups. Find likely early adopters.
output: Summary: 12 fintech companies match regulated workflows and recent compliance hiring signals.
Top lead: a Series B payments company with public compliance roles and expanding audit needs.
Outreach angle: lead with faster audit preparation and reduced manual evidence collection.

output_examples.input: Review my developer tool repository and find companies that may need it.
output: Summary: the product appears to help engineering teams manage sensitive AI coding workflows.
Best targets: security-conscious software teams in finance, healthcare, and legal technology.
Next step: validate top accounts with current job postings and public security initiatives.

output_examples.input: Find partnership prospects for a remote work consulting practice in the Bay Area.
output: Summary: 10 companies show remote hiring, distributed teams, or recent office changes.
Priority lead: a mid-size SaaS company hiring remote managers across several departments.
Conversation starter: reference their distributed hiring growth and offer onboarding process support.

best_practices: Provide product details, customer profile, geography, and deal constraints before asking for leads.
Ask for sources and verify company facts before adding prospects to a CRM.
Use public information responsibly and respect privacy, consent, and opt-out requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for private personal data, scraped contact lists, or spam targeting.
Do not treat fit scores as final qualification without human review.
Do not request leads without industry, location, size, or pain point constraints.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces prioritized lead research with fit reasons, target roles, outreach angles, and suggested next steps.

faq.question: Can it use my codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the agent to inspect a product repository when you run it from that directory.

faq.question: Does it find personal email addresses?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on companies, public context, professional roles, and responsible outreach strategy.

faq.question: How accurate are the fit scores?
faq.answer: Fit scores are research estimates. Verify each lead with current sources and sales judgment.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is useful for sales teams, founders, consultants, and business development teams.

faq.question: Does it replace a CRM or prospecting database?
faq.answer: No. It helps create and structure research that you can review before using other sales tools.
